core_conclusion: The published 2H MoSSe GSFE has a non-removable registry-space inversion-odd component, and matched same-spectrum symmetry operations remove or reverse directional response as expected.

caption: Figure 1. Material registry asymmetry and matched symmetry contracts. (a) Translation-centered asymmetric 2H MoSSe GSFE. (b) Matched same-spectrum inversion-even surface on the same color scale. (c) Translation-minimized odd RMS fraction for the published 2H/3R controls on a log10 display; the exact-zero symmetric control is placed at 1e-18 only as a plotting floor and is labeled 0. (d) At theta=1.5 deg, paired global thresholds show directional splitting for the original landscape, degeneracy for the matched symmetrized landscape, and exact threshold/winding reversal after spatial inversion. The controls are mathematical symmetry tests, not a demonstrated physical polarity-reversal law.
